backgrounds.name: Pink wild rose
backgrounds.prompt: Use case: style-transfer / precise composition edit. Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: one of the user's approved simple watercolor floral backgrounds. Image 2 is a LAYOUT REFERENCE ONLY: the original Pips & Petals game screenshot. Edit Image 1 into a revised standalone background painting, preserving its flower species, petal color palette, simple loose transparent watercolor strokes, small centers, natural leaves and subtle paper grain. Use the diagonal arrangement of the watercolor panel in Image 2, but only the background artwork: DO NOT include dice, game UI, typography, borders, or any text. Maintain Image 1's wide landscape aspect ratio around 1.85:1. REQUIRED COMPOSITION: actual open FLOWERS AND A FEW LEAVES in BOTH LOWER-LEFT and UPPER-RIGHT corners, not just a token bud or petal in one corner. A small natural cluster of 1–3 open blooms in each corner is enough; duplicate/adapt the target flowers as needed. Lower-left cluster stays close to the left and bottom edges, mostly within the left 27% and bottom 45%. Upper-right cluster stays close to the top and right edges, mostly within the right 27% and top 38%. Organic asymmetry, slightly larger lower-left cluster. Preserve the SIMPLE hand-painted flowers; don't turn them into ornate bouquets. PROTECT READING SPACE: upper-left quadrant stays free of stems, leaves and flowers; lower-right quadrant stays free of stems, leaves and flowers; the broad middle stays unobstructed, quiet and low contrast. No continuous floral border, no vines crossing the reading zones. COLOR WASH: add a visible but very faint, EVEN translucent wash of blush pink across the whole paper, including the middle, upper left and lower right. The center must have a touch of color rather than blank white, but be luminous and pale enough for dark navy text to read easily. Roughly 5–7% pigment on 93–95% white paper, soft uniform tint with subtle watercolor texture, no dark pools, dramatic streaks, busy blotches, gradients or vignette in reading zones. No lettering, watermark, shadow or photo effects.
